boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: Ten documented Macalester rituals and recurring campus events, from a paintable boulder to snow-day Pushball.

cards.title: Paint The Rock
cards.subtitle: A 700-pound campus boulder
cards.notes: Bring an approved message and supplies, then add a fresh layer to this long-running campus rite of passage. Ask campus staff about current painting guidance.
cards.short_summary: Macalester’s paintable 700-pound boulder turns student messages into a changing public landmark.
cards.evidence_claim: Macalester identifies painting The Rock as a campus rite of passage and describes it as a 700-pound boulder.
cards.access_notes: Follow current campus guidance before painting.

cards.title: Pushball in the Snow
cards.subtitle: A giant-ball campus game
cards.notes: Watch the Program Board calendar for the next installment, then join the group effort to move the oversized inflatable ball across a snowy field.
cards.short_summary: Pushball converts a snowy lawn and an oversized inflatable ball into a Macalester group game.
cards.evidence_claim: Macalester describes Pushball as a recently revived tradition using an approximately eight-foot inflatable ball in freshly fallen snow.
cards.access_notes: Check Program Board announcements for scheduling and participation details.

cards.title: Winter Ball
cards.subtitle: Program Board’s winter tradition
cards.notes: Look for the Program Board’s event details during the academic year and follow its venue, ticketing, attire, and entry instructions for that edition.
cards.short_summary: Winter Ball is one of the recurring traditions organized by Macalester’s student Program Board.
cards.evidence_claim: Macalester’s Center for Student Leadership and Engagement lists Winter Ball among Program Board’s well-beloved traditions.
cards.access_notes: Format, access, and any cost vary by year; consult the current event listing.

cards.title: Celebrate Founding Day
cards.subtitle: Macalester’s birthday observance
cards.notes: Follow the college’s Founding Day announcements to see that year’s birthday events and historical programming; the tradition was revived in 2004.
cards.short_summary: Founding Day marks Macalester’s 1874 charter and has returned as a recurring college birthday celebration.
cards.evidence_claim: Macalester says Founding Day began in 1938, commemorates its March 5, 1874 charter, and was revived in March 2004.
cards.access_notes: Programming changes by year; use the college’s current Founding Day information.

cards.title: Bingo for Books
cards.subtitle: An early-year Program Board event
cards.notes: Check Program Board announcements near the start of the academic year, arrive according to the event instructions, and play the campus version of bingo.
cards.short_summary: Bingo for Books is Macalester’s recurring early-year bingo tradition.
cards.evidence_claim: Macalester describes Bingo for Books as an annual beginning-of-year tradition, and its student leadership office lists it among Program Board traditions.
cards.access_notes: Confirm the current date, venue, entry process, and any cost with Program Board.

cards.title: Springfest
cards.subtitle: A Program Board spring tradition
cards.notes: Monitor the Program Board calendar in spring for the lineup and location, then take in the event’s music and outdoor campus atmosphere.
cards.short_summary: Springfest is a recurring Macalester spring event associated with local bands and campus downtime.
cards.evidence_claim: Macalester’s student leadership office lists Springfest among Program Board’s well-beloved traditions; an admissions page describes it as an April event with local bands.
cards.access_notes: Check the current Program Board listing for access and schedule details.

cards.title: Midnight Breakfast
cards.subtitle: A fall-semester study-break tradition
cards.notes: Watch for the end-of-semester announcement and follow the dining event’s entry details; it pairs nighttime breakfast with a pause before study days.
cards.short_summary: Midnight Breakfast is Macalester’s fall-semester nighttime breakfast study break.
cards.evidence_claim: Macalester calls Midnight Breakfast a tradition held at the end of the fall semester, and an alumni story documents its annual Mock Weekly distribution.
cards.access_notes: Attendance and dining access may be limited to the campus community; verify the current event notice.

cards.title: Hear the Peace Prayer
cards.subtitle: An opening-and-closing academic-year reading
cards.notes: Attend Opening Convocation, major gatherings, or Commencement when open to observe students read the prayer in their native languages.
cards.short_summary: The Peace Prayer bookends Macalester’s academic year through multilingual student readings.
cards.evidence_claim: Macalester states that five students read the Peace Prayer in their native tongues at Opening Convocation, major gatherings, and Commencement.
cards.access_notes: Public access depends on the particular college ceremony.

cards.entity_name: Minnesota Scottish Fair and Highland Games
cards.title: Scottish Fair at Macalester
cards.subtitle: A recurring campus-hosted Highland gathering
cards.notes: Use the Pipe Band’s current announcement and the fair organizer’s event information before visiting; campus hosting is scheduled for July 18, 2026.
cards.short_summary: Macalester’s Pipe Band continues a campus connection to the Minnesota Scottish Fair and Highland Games.
cards.evidence_claim: Macalester says the fair first came to campus in 1973 and its Pipe Band page announces the 2026 fair on the Macalester campus.
cards.access_notes: The 2026 Pipe Band announcement directs visitors to the fair organizer for current event details.

cards.title: Pick Up The MOCK Weekly
cards.subtitle: The Mac Weekly’s Midnight Breakfast edition
cards.notes: At fall-semester Midnight Breakfast, look for The Mac Weekly’s humorous special issue, created by the staff for distribution before campus study days.
cards.short_summary: The MOCK Weekly is a recurring satirical special edition timed to Midnight Breakfast.
cards.evidence_claim: Macalester’s alumni publication states that The Mac Weekly staff creates the humorous MOCK Weekly each fall semester to distribute at Midnight Breakfast.
cards.source_title: My Time as an Editor for The Mac Weekly
cards.access_notes: Availability is tied to the fall Midnight Breakfast event and may be limited.
